headline.title: I/O 2026
headline.summary: At Google I/O 2026, the company unveiled new initiatives aimed at enhancing the accessibility and utility of AI technologies for users. The announcements included a range of features and tools designed to integrate AI more effectively into everyday tasks.

articles.title: I/O 2026: Welcome to the agentic Gemini era
articles.summary: Google I/O 2026 introduced the "agentic Gemini" era, highlighting advancements in AI technology and its integration into various applications. The event showcased new features and tools designed to enhance user interaction and productivity through AI-driven solutions.

articles.title: Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action
articles.summary: Gemini 3.5 has been introduced as an advanced AI model, enhancing capabilities in text processing and multi-modal functionalities. This update aims to improve user interaction and expand the application of AI in various domains.

articles.title: Everything new in our Google AI subscriptions, fresh from I/O 2026
articles.summary: Google has announced new features and enhancements to its AI subscription plans during the I/O 2026 event, emphasizing increased capabilities and benefits while maintaining the same pricing structure. The updates aim to provide users with more powerful tools and perks integrated into a single subscription plan.

articles.title: How AI Mode is changing the way people search in the U.S.
articles.summary: The article discusses the impact of AI Mode on search behaviors in the U.S., highlighting how users are increasingly integrating AI tools into their search processes. It features a graphic that visually represents various elements associated with AI-assisted searches.

articles.title: Everything Announced at Google I/O 2026: Gemini, Search, Smart Glasses
articles.summary: At Google I/O 2026, the company announced enhancements to its Gemini AI models and a revamped search experience, along with the introduction of AI agents across various applications. Additionally, new smart glasses are set to launch this fall.

articles.title: OlmoEarth v1.1: A more efficient family of models
articles.summary: OlmoEarth has released version 1.1 of its model family, which features enhancements aimed at improving efficiency and performance. The update includes optimizations that allow for better resource management and faster processing times in various applications.

articles.title: The 13 biggest announcements at Google I/O 2026
articles.summary: At Google I/O 2026, the company unveiled a new family of Gemini 3.5 AI models, introduced enhancements for Search and Gmail, and provided updates on its Project Aura smart glasses. The keynote highlighted a range of AI-related advancements and features aimed at improving user experience across its platforms.

articles.title: With Gemini 3.5 Flash, Google bets its next AI wave on agents, not chatbots
articles.summary: Google introduced Gemini 3.5 Flash, its latest AI model designed for autonomous task execution and software development, during its annual developer conference. This new model marks a strategic shift from traditional chatbots to more advanced AI agents.

articles.title: Google introduces Gemini Spark, a 24/7 agentic assistant with Gmail integration
articles.summary: Google has unveiled Gemini Spark, a new 24/7 personal assistant that integrates with Gmail and is built on its Gemini base models combined with technology from Google Antigravity. The announcement was made during the Google I/O developer conference.

articles.title: Google launches Antigravity 2.0 with an updated desktop app and CLI tool
articles.summary: Google has launched Antigravity 2.0, featuring an updated desktop app and CLI tool, alongside a new AI Ultra plan priced at $100, which offers users five times the usage limit compared to the AI Pro plan. This update aims to enhance user experience and accessibility for AI tools.

articles.title: Gemini Spark Is Google’s Response to OpenClaw’s 24/7 AI Agent
articles.summary: Google has introduced Gemini Spark, an AI agent that operates continuously to manage tasks such as spending money and sending emails. This development is seen as a direct response to OpenClaw's 24/7 AI agent capabilities.
